post.description:
Activates the BitNinja security license on the load balancer's underlying VM. BitNinja is an add-on, server-protection layer (billed separately - see `can_support_bitninja` / `bitninja_cost` in LB Plans). The path takes the `vm_id` of the load balancer's node (the `node_detail.vm_id` field from List Load Balancers), not the load balancer (appliance) ID. The response returns the install `command_to_execute`.

The request body is an empty JSON object.

parameters.name: vm_id
parameters.description: The `vm_id` field from the `node_detail` object in the List Load Balancers response.
x-constraints: must be a valid VM ID

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the project to scope the request to. Required integer project ID.
x-constraints: must be a valid integer project ID

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: API key used to authenticate the request

schema.description: No fields are required - send an empty JSON object. The target is identified by the `vm_id` path parameter.

command_to_execute.description: Shell command to install the BitNinja agent on the appliance.

delete.description: Terminates the BitNinja security license on the load balancer's underlying VM. As with enabling, the path takes the load balancer node's `vm_id` (the `node_detail.vm_id` field), not the appliance ID. No request body is required.
